visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a light blue striped shirt over a grey tank top and a black backpack, stands in front of a digital background of Shibuya Crossing. He touches his head with both hands, looking stressed. (2) He looks around as if searching for something, then gestures like he is hailing a taxi. (3) He holds up a white smartphone displaying the white and blue 'GO' taxi app logo. (4) He is seated in the back of a taxi, wearing a seatbelt, holding his phone and looking happy while a stylized taxi driver icon appears on screen. (5) He interacts with his phone screen, showing a white interface. (6) The background changes to a traditional Japanese street with wooden buildings and red lanterns; he looks at his phone and then looks up with an expression of surprise and joy. (7) Back to the urban background, he carries a white paper shopping bag and wipes his brow, looking exhausted. (8) He holds his phone again as a high-quality graphic of a black Toyota Alphard luxury van overlays the screen. (9) Inside the taxi again, he talks directly to the camera with high energy, giving a thumbs up and showing the phone screen multiple times before ending with a wide-eyed, excited expression.

(5) [Subtitle]: 目的地是東京車站對吧? 請繫好安全帶. 好 麻煩你了. (6) [Subtitle]: GO APP 支援英文 就算不會日文也不用擔心 因為是用APP預約的 所以也不用再說一次目的地. (7) [Subtitle]: 總共是2000日圓 用GO Pay付款對吧? 好 謝謝. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy Mandarin speech starts with a bright, up-tempo synthesizer pop BGM. A percussive 'ding' sound effects text appearance. The main speaker uses an animated, slightly exaggerated tone with high pitch variability. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound triggers a new phase. A secondary male voice is heard speaking Japanese with a polite, professional tone typical of a taxi driver. The main speaker responds with a cheerful, energetic Mandarin exclamation. (3) The fast-paced narration continues, punctuated by regular bubble 'pop' sounds as app features are listed. The BGM remains steady and upbeat. (4) Another 'whoosh' transition leads to a comedic tone shift where the speaker's voice rises in a questioning manner. A 'ping' sound effect accompanies the resolution of the scene. (5) Final summary involves a loud, high-arousal vocal delivery with a strong command tone for the call to action, ending with a final energetic stinger and a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Solution -> Feature Breakdown -> Scenarios -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tutorial for the 'GO' taxi app in Japan. It uses a comedic and high-energy storytelling approach to demonstrate how the app solves common traveler problems, such as language barriers, destination communication, payment difficulties, and booking in remote areas or for large groups.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator repeatedly names the 'GO' app, shows its interface, demonstrates its specific features like 'GO Pay' and 'GO Premium', and ends with a direct download call to action.
